pre_registration: RESEARCH_PLAN.md Experiment 1: Tier-2 model-based detector (Binoculars/Fast-DetectGPT) arm. Not run when Experiment 1 was first reported; disclosed as dropped in AMENDMENTS.md, then run on local GPU rather than left unrun -- this file is that run.

model_substitution.reason: 6GB VRAM budget on the available machine; RESEARCH_PLAN.md explicitly permits substituting smaller models and recording which. Falcon-7B-fit thresholds (BINOCULARS_ACCURACY_THRESHOLD / BINOCULARS_FPR_THRESHOLD) from the original paper are not reused here -- only the score's ranking ability (AUC) is needed for this gate, not a calibrated accept/reject threshold.
